what: Screen-size sections are stacked, and you move one at a time with one wheel tick, the up/down keys, a vertical swipe (5% of the plate height) or the dot buttons. Going down, the current section lifts away entirely by −100%, revealing the next one lying underneath. Going up, the lifted section covers back down from above (1s cubic-bezier(.55,.085,0,.99), which lifts slowly then snaps and has a long tail). For 1.3s after a move no next move is accepted. A section whose inside is longer (data-key="scroll") scrolls inside the section first and advances only when it reaches the end — for character and campaign first pages that turn one scene at a time like a picture book

options.ease: Curve — four cubic-bezier numbers ("0.55,0.085,0,0.99") or a CSS curve name, default the original .pp-easing
options.lock: Lock time (ms) after a flip that blocks the next flip, default 1300 (original scrollingSpeed 700 + 600 pause)
options.swipe: Vertical push distance per flip (% of board height), default 5
options.[data-fx-part=page]: Sheets to stack (direct children of the board) — data-key="scroll" Add it and a long section scrolls within.
options.[data-fx-part=dots]: Dot list slot (optional) — create one button per section and set aria-current on the current one
options.fx:page: Event fired from the board on each flip (detail.index)

note: pagePiling 1.5.6 is a jQuery plugin, so this part rebuilds the same transition (stacking order·−100% retract·curve·lock·scroll within long sections) without dependencies. The wheel is intercepted only over the panel (preventDefault), phone vertical swipes are not blocked (passive) and page only by distance on release — if the first page is a panel covering the whole screen, it pages one section at a time as is. The original site copy (bear-scene-storybook-company/index.html) uses the library as is
